candidates.description: The New York Jets entered Sunday 0-7 and beat Cincinnati 39 to 38 for their first win of the season.
candidates.comedy_use: Potential parallel with a fantasy team entering the week 0-7.

candidates.description: Dodgers-Blue Jays World Series Game 3 lasted 18 innings and ended on a Freddie Freeman walk-off home run.
candidates.comedy_use: Potential contrast if the fantasy week had no close matchups despite another sport producing an absurdly long close game.

candidates.description: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau made their first public appearance as a couple in Paris.
